name: Maurin Bonesplitter
summary: At Ghost Walker Post, Maurin Bonesplitter watches the Burning Blade in Desolace. Keldran sent the Forsaken scholar to watch the cult's demonic activity. Maurin draws on ancient lore to undermine the cult and scorns its members as fools blind to the dark powers directing them.

sections.title: A Scholar Among Outcasts
sections.body: At Ghost Walker Post, Maurin Bonesplitter is one of the few undead among the tauren and Horde residents. He is a learned spellcaster rather than a soldier, with deep knowledge of forbidden histories and occult forces. His learning and sharp mind caught Keldran's attention. So Keldran sent Maurin to Desolace to watch the growing demonic presence and direct focused attacks against it.

sections.title: Contempt for the Burning Blade
sections.body: Across Desolace, Maurin reserves much of his scorn for the Burning Blade. He despises their reckless ambition and mocks them for mistaking borrowed power for their own. To him, they are thralls blind to the demonic masters who bind them. Maurin uses scrying spells and ritual knowledge to enlist Horde adventurers in disrupting the cult's summonings and weakening its operations across the barren landscape.

faq.answer: Maurin Bonesplitter is a Forsaken warlock and scholar at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace. Keldran appointed him to turn his knowledge of ancient lore and dark magic against the Burning Blade cult in the region.

faq.q: Why is an undead staying at a tauren post?
aliases: why is maurin at ghost walker post
faq.answer: Ghost Walker Post is a Horde settlement in Desolace. Keldran stationed Maurin there to watch and fight the Burning Blade cultists in the surrounding wilderness.

faq.q: What is Maurin's opinion of the Burning Blade?
aliases: why does maurin hate burning blade
faq.answer: Maurin holds the Burning Blade in deep contempt. He sees its members as ignorant pawns who mistake borrowed power for their own and cannot see the demonic masters controlling them.

faq.q: Who sent Maurin Bonesplitter to Desolace?
faq.answer: Keldran appointed Maurin to his post in Desolace. He recognized Maurin's knowledge of cult practices and ancient lore, then tasked him with hindering and eliminating the Burning Blade in the region.

faq.q: What kind of tasks does Maurin give adventurers?
faq.answer: Maurin asks adventurers to investigate the Burning Blade and bring him a Hatefury Shadowstalker scalp and a naga Oracle Crystal. He uses these reagents to break scrying wards and find the demon lord behind the cult.

faq.q: Is Maurin affiliated with the Cenarion Circle or the Horde?
faq.answer: Maurin is a Forsaken loyal to the Horde. From Ghost Walker Post, he aids Horde champions fighting cult activity in the wastes.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you can see how arcane study and an enemy's weaknesses can serve alongside necromantic might.
As a warlock, you may recognize Maurin's grasp of demonic pacts. His contempt shows the peril of serving greater fiends.
As a mage at Ghost Walker Post, you can appreciate Maurin's careful use of specialized counters to unravel dark rituals.
As a member of the Horde, you can see how Maurin brings Undercity's specialized support and dark scholarly knowledge to western outposts. There, he aids tauren allies against demonic corruption.
